summary:

The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has announced a September 17 Washington, DC meeting to discuss a crypto-mimicking round-the-clock trading of US stocks.  Per the agency, panelists will include several prominent players in legacy finance, including Citi, BlackRock, Nasdaq, Charles Schwab, Jane Street, and the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). SEC meeting on crypto-adjacent …
content: The US Securities and Exchange Commission has announced a Washington, DC meeting to discuss round-the-clock trading for US stocks. Scheduled for September 17, the roundtable will feature prominent legacy finance players, including representatives from Nasdaq, the New York Stock Exchange, Citi, BlackRock, Charles Schwab, and Jane Street, to explore a trading model similar to cryptocurrency markets.
